title: Glasses with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glasses frame: left lens -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54A' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- right lens -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54A' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <path d='M48 42 Q50 36 52 42' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- temple arms -->
  <line x1='16' y1='38' x2='6' y2='32' stroke='#FFD54A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='38' x2='94' y2='32' stroke='#FFD54A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lens shine left -->
  <path d='M22 36 Q26 30 32 30' fill='none' stroke='#FF8A65' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- lens shine right -->
  <path d='M58 36 Q62 30 68 30' fill='none' stroke='#FF8A65' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='44' r='4' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='4' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF7A9A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF7A9A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- big smile -->
  <path d='M34 62 Q50 80 66 62' fill='none' stroke='#FF7A9A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little grin corners -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FF7A9A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FF7A9A'/>
</svg>
